strategy: POL-BTC FR Differential Signal Orthogonalization — Remove OP+SEI+APT+TIA+FIL+SAND Common Factors (K635 IMX Pattern Application)
decision_rationale: Orthogonalized POL signal (6-factor, W=168h): G5 PASS + OOS Sharpe=23.41. Non-critical fails: 2 gates. Blockers post-orth: SEI=0.2050, TIA=0.0638, APT=0.1627, FIL=0.0331, SAND=0.0441, OP=0.0640. 6-factor IS R²=0.3788, OOS R²=0.0114. Recommend 60d paper-trade before live deployment.

k635.approach: OLS: IMX-BTC ~ α + β_SHIB*SHIB + β_TIA*TIA + β_SEI*SEI + residual

k611_context.k648_approach: 6-factor OLS residualization: POL-BTC ~ α + β_OP*OP + β_SEI*SEI + β_APT*APT + β_TIA*TIA + β_FIL*FIL + β_SAND*SAND + residual. Largest orthogonalization attempt in K648 series (6 factors vs 1-3 in prior waves). POL = Polygon PoS sidechain + zkEVM — distinct from rollup L2s (ARB/OP) but shares alt-cap regime factor with many mid-cap perps.

signal_config.strategy_type: FR differential carry — ORTHOGONALIZED vs 6-factor common cluster
signal_config.direction_rule: sign(W-hour rolling mean of 6-factor OLS residual of fr_diff_pol)
signal_config.pnl_source: signal * fr_diff_pol (carry from actual POL-BTC position)

comparison.note: POL-BTC fr_diff regressed on 6 common sidechain/alt-cap factors. 6-factor = most complete removal. 3-factor = top-3 blocker removal (OP,SEI,APT). 2-factor = minimal viable (OP+APT only). POL specific alpha hypothesis: Polygon zkEVM AggLayer demand, MATIC→POL migration premium, PoS validator re-staking cycles.
